svg.title: Architecture of foresight
svg.desc: The Rust crate foresight holds every model, the backtest, decomposition and cleaning. The R package foresightr (extendr) and the Python package pyforesight (PyO3) call it; Rust programs use it directly. foresight-go is an independent Go port checked against results recorded by the crate. The crate is checked against the R packages forecast and prophet.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: One implementation in Rust; R and Python call it, so the numbers are the same everywhere.
